cause.what_happened: This is the third fall of 9% or more in four sessions (10-01, 10-02, 10-05). Today opened -16.7% and recovered 6.7% intraday, to -11.1% at the 15:04 ET screen, on 10x normal volume ($1.79m traded against a market cap of about $2.1m). There was no press release, no 6-K and no EDGAR full-text hit after 2026-09-23. The likeliest driver is continued selling of newly issued shares.

findings.finding: Supply overhang still working: Class A shares rose from about 0.82m after the 2026-08-21 split to 1.88m on 2026-09-23. That is consistent with exercise of the 1.29m post-split pre-funded warrants from the GPU deal, so up to about 0.2m warrant shares may remain. On top sit $14.5m of secured convertible debentures with down-round features, about 7x the roughly $2.1m market cap, plus a going-concern flag (20-F, 2026-09-18) and a restated shareholders' deficit of $6.0m. Holders who receive near-free shares are sellers into any bounce in the 2026-10-06 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: There is no dated event. The supply is continuous: warrant shares carry only nominal exercise cost and can be sold in any session, including 2026-10-06. Today's turnover of about 85% of the share count in one day shows the holders are active now.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the warrants were issued, the stock's falls have mostly continued: of the 12 baseline events from 2026-07-06 to 2026-10-02, 7 fell further by the next close (10-01 -9.35%, 10-02 -11.12%). Over all 112 comparable falls the median is 0.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices a seller who has been active today, not whether the remaining warrant and conversion supply keeps coming tomorrow. If the overhang were spent, the 6.7% intraday recovery would have held up the gap and volume would be falling; instead this is the third heavy-volume fall in four sessions.
findings.independence: Separate filings agree: the 20-F (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1735556/000110465926108989/btog-20260630x20f.htm) gives the pre-funded warrants and debentures, and the 6-K/A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1735556/000110465926108949/tm2625631d1_6ka.htm) gives the down-round warrant deemed dividend ($7.7m) and the shareholders' deficit. Both are the issuer's own documents; there is no outside confirmation of who is selling.

outside_window.finding: Bid price is $1.12, within 25% of the $1 Nasdaq minimum. The company has done 1:60 (2026-01-20) and 1:5 (2026-08-21) reverse splits within the past year, so a renewed deficiency may get no cure period. Any notice needs 30 consecutive business days below $1, far beyond 2026-10-06.

Further draws on the convertible note facility: $2m of a $10m maximum closed on 2026-06-29, at a conversion price of $1.63 pre-split, subject to adjustment. A new draw is possible at any time, but none is dated.
